'''Huttese''' was a [[Writing/Legends|writing]] system used on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was also used on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Description==
Huttese<ref name="Bound Trivia" /> was a [[Writing/Legends|writing]] system notable for using different symbols for lowercase and uppercase letters. The alphabet was widely used on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Friends" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
===Republic Era===
[[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano's]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta eve Classic]] had a Huttese M painted on its [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. The same character was displayed on the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] module of [[Teemto Pagalies' Podracer/Legends|Teemto Pagalies' Podracer]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> and on the engines on [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt's]] podracer and [[Ebe Endocott's Podracer/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott's Podracer]].<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

[[File:Bilbousa.png|thumb|left|300px|Huttese signage at the Bilbousa Basaar]]
The sign over the entrance to the [[Bilbousa Bazaar/Legends|Bilbousa Bazaar]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] was written in Huttese and read "[[Bilbousa/Legends|Bilbousa]]". A vertical [[Color/Legends|yellow]] sign on the [[Bilbousa saloon/Legends|Bilbousa saloon]] used the same script, , reading "SALOO" <small>''[sic]''</smalL>. The over the entrance to one of the businesses read "[[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|pablo's pawnshop]]" <small>''[sic]''</small>, while a vertical sign on the roof used the same script. The [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at the ship stall were lit up with [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] signs written in Huttese, that were projected onto the hull.<ref name="Friends" />

A [[Painting/Legends|poster]] in the bazaar showed a [[Music/Legends|musical]] [[Band/Legends|band]] with a caption reading "Live at the [[Cantina/Legends|Cantina]]".<ref name="Friends Concept">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-concept-art-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Concept Art Gallery|quote=Poster artwork by Polina Hristova seen in Bilbousa bazaar with the caption "Live at the Cantina"}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> A poster inside the saloon showed the famous [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] and read "Autographs [[Saturday/Legends|Saturday]] at 10 AM".<ref name="Friends Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery|quote=Inside the saloon (right next to the Gotal that narrowly misses getting hit by a flying ax) is a poster advertising that Sebulba will be signing autographs on "Saturday at 10am."}} {{C|Slide 8}} {{C|Note: The period at the end does not actually appear in the episode, and the transliteration fails to take into account that the [[Painting|poster]] says "10'''AM'''", in capital letters}}</ref> Next to it, there was a poster showing the silhouette of a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] looking [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] doing a pole dance, with a Huttese caption reading "Dancers every [[Friday/Legends|FRIDAY]] [[Standard day/Legends|NIGHT]]!!"<ref name="Friends" /> The Twi'lek poster also appeared on the door leading out of the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] at the [[79's/Legends|79's]] cantina on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Orders" />

The logo of a traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[Circus/Legends|circus]] attraction run by [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo]] said "Preigo's Carnival" in Huttese. However, when the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] read the sign, he misread it as "[[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonders]]."<ref name="Bound Trivia" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Huttesealternativealphabetmapping.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A fan mapping of Huttese, based on both [[canon]] and Legends sources. Notice the different upper case and lower case letters.]]
During the filming of {{Film|2}}, Huttese characters were used on [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker's]] headstone.<ref name="365 Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref>

A hand-posted bill created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Missing in Action]]" shows a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] with the accompanying text "interior decorator wanted; call [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jaba]] <small>''[sic]''</small> for appointment".<ref name="Missing Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-trivia-gallery|text="Missing in Action" Trivia Gallery|quote=Another posting showcases an ill-fated Snivvian frozen in carbonite, with the text "Interior Decorator Wanted; call Jabba for appointment."}} {{C|Slide 10}} {{C|Note: The period at the end does not actually appear in the episode, and the transliteration fails to take into account that "[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]" is misspelled as "Jaba", and that the first four words are spelled in lowercase; they do not start with a capital letter, like the transliteration suggests}}</ref> Yet, the bill does not actually show up in the episode.<ref name="Missing">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>
